title: ProdigeUI Prompt Template
description: Schema for ProdigeUI prompt templates. Defines the structure of templates used to generate UI/UX artifacts with enterprise-grade quality.

useCase.description: The use case this template targets.

context.description: Context section describing the scenario, audience, platform, and relevant background for the prompt. Must explicitly state what the agent is designing and for whom.

constraints.description: List of constraints and rules the output must adhere to (Design_Rules, Token_System usage, accessibility requirements, Quality_Gate criteria).

outputCriteria.description: Criteria defining what constitutes acceptable output from this template.

format.description: Expected output format (e.g., component code, design spec, page layout).

qualityChecks.description: List of quality checks the output must pass.

accessibilityRequirements.description: Specific accessibility requirements for the output (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance).

examples.description: One or more examples of expected output along with acceptance criteria.

description.description: Brief description of what this example demonstrates.

output.description: The expected output example (code snippet, design spec excerpt, etc.).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Criteria that this specific example satisfies.

references.description: References to other ProdigeUI artifacts that this template uses or requires.

tokens.description: Design tokens that must be used in the output.

components.description: Components that must be used or referenced.

designRules.description: Design rules that must be adhered to.

category.description: Category of artifact this template produces.
